name: robat_control
description: Your own Binance trading bot's console API: open and closed positions, orders, fills, signals, risk controls, and the maintenance actions that move a stop or close a position.

robat.description: Read and control the user's own Binance trading bot: positions, orders, fills, signals, risk state, and position maintenance actions
robat.instruction: Use this for anything about the user's live trading account: what is open, why a trade exists, realised P&L, risk halts, and moving a stop or closing a position. Start with get_dashboard or list_active_positions; drill into get_position_detail for the lot ledger. Write tools all require confirm=True and act on real money, so state the exact trader_id and symbol you are about to change and get agreement first. Never guess a symbol for manage_position — pass it, or let the bot refuse.
